name: com.abcdancer/events
title: ABCDancer dance events
description: Social dance events (bachata, salsa, kizomba, zouk): search by city, date and style. Read-only.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming social dance events (bachata, salsa, kizomba, zouk socials, parties and festivals) by meaning, in any language. The query may contain a place and a time, which are applied as exact filters: "bachata this weekend in Amsterdam", "salsa tonight Barcelona", "festivales de kizomba en primavera", "zouk festival in March". Relative dates (tonight, this weekend, next month, a weekday, a month, a season) are read in the local time of the place asked for, in English, Spanish, Dutch, French, Portuguese, Italian, German and Romanian. Explicit city/country/style/from/to arguments override what the query says. Returns compact events, best match first, each with its `url` (the event's page on abcdancer.com) and, when the organiser sells tickets online, `tickets`: a link that opens the organiser's ticket page.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in their own words.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "Amsterdam", "the-hague", "Barcelona". A city includes the towns of its area.

country.description: ISO country code or English name, e.g. "nl", "Spain".

style.description: Dance style. "bachata" includes sensual, dominican and influence.

kind.description: "festival": festivals, congresses and dance weekends only; "event": single nights (socials, parties) only.

limit.description: How many events to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details of one event: times, venue and address, price, line-up, description, `tickets` (a link that opens the organiser's ticket page), organiser links, other dates of a recurring night and other events nearby. Pass the `id` or the `url` from a search result (an abcdancer.com/events or events.abcdancer.com event link works too).

id_or_url.description: Event id (8 hex characters, e.g. "3cc4d06a") or an event URL.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: The cities that have upcoming dance events in the calendar, most events first, with the count of upcoming events and the link to each city's page. Also the known dance styles. Coverage: Amsterdam and the rest of the Netherlands first, then Spain (Madrid, Barcelona), Belgium, Germany, France, Portugal, Turkey and nearby festivals.

tools.name: upcoming
tools.description: Every listed event in a time window, in date and start-time order, optionally for one city, country, style or kind. Use it for "where can I dance tonight in Amsterdam?" or "what's on this weekend?". `when` is read in the local time of the city; "tonight" keeps showing the current night until 05:00. Default: the next 7 days. Each event comes with its `url` (the event's page on abcdancer.com) and, when there is one, `tickets`: a link that opens the organiser's ticket page.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "Amsterdam", "the-hague", "Barcelona". A city includes the towns of its area.

country.description: ISO country code or English name, e.g. "nl", "Spain".

style.description: Dance style. "bachata" includes sensual, dominican and influence.

kind.description: "festival": festivals, congresses and dance weekends only; "event": single nights (socials, parties) only.

when.description: One of tonight, today, tomorrow, this-weekend, next-weekend, this-week, next-week, next-7-days, this-month, next-month, or a date like 2026-12-31. Default next-7-days.

limit.description: How many events to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.
